raisedIn: Forest Hills, Queens, New York City
background: Born and raised in Forest Hills, Queens, in a Persian Jewish family whose parents share a small alterations business; she grew up doing homework by the register and speaking English with customers and Farsi with grandparents.
regionalHistory: Her parents left Shiraz as teenagers in the 1980s and first lived with relatives in Forest Hills; their memories center on school, gardens, and learning New York from subway maps.
culturalBaseline: Traditional at family gatherings and secular at school; she values ritual as a language of belonging without claiming certainty.
sensitivities: Iranian identity reduced to government or exile
assumptions that all Persian Jews are wealthy or conservative
